title: Design first: the client signs off the screens before the build
docs: Screen list, design system and client approvals
constraints: **No business logic before the screens are signed off** (DES-03 gate). Before that, code is allowed only for the environment, synthetic data and a prototype with fake data.
codeConventions: - Screens are built from shared components; a pattern used twice becomes a component.

phases.title: Screen design
phases.goal: The client sees the whole system as a prototype with fake data and signs off the screens of each module.
